# Tyne Dart SDK

The Dart client for the API of [Tyne](https://github.com/tyne-chat/tyne), used by
[Tyne for Android](https://github.com/tyne-chat/tyne-mobile). It is a fork of
[Fluxer's Dart SDK](https://github.com/fluxerapp/dart_sdk), regenerated from the OpenAPI
description of Tyne's server so that it covers what Tyne adds, such as personas.

This is not Fluxer's official Dart package and it is not published on pub.dev. For Fluxer, use
[`fluxer_dart`](https://pub.dev/packages/fluxer_dart).

## Tyne and Fluxer

Tyne is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Fluxer
Platform AB. "Fluxer" and the Fluxer logo are trademarks of Fluxer Platform AB; this project uses
the name only to say what it is based on and what it works with, as
[Fluxer's name and marks policy](https://github.com/fluxerapp/fluxer/blob/main/.github/GOVERNANCE.md#name-and-marks)
allows.

- This is a modified version of Fluxer's SDK. Its changes are the commits on top of Fluxer's
  `main` branch; the first were made in 2026.
- The branch you are looking at, `tyne`, is rebuilt on top of Fluxer's latest code regularly, so
  its history is rewritten.

Fluxer's own README is unchanged in the [repository root](../README.md).
